paragraphs: At dusk, the companions found a dead troll in the village square. Narion knelt beside it. There wasn’t a single wound. A fighter in a bear mask stood nearby.

paragraphs.text: “I wore this one when the troll came for me,” he said, lifting a green serpent mask from his belt. “Its shadow coiled around him and stole his breath.”

paragraphs: Another troll charged out of the ruined smithy. Still wearing the bear mask, the fighter met the charge head-on. The impact shook loose the roof tiles. Step by step, he drove the troll back into the smithy.
The troll vanished into the dark. The fighter chose an owl mask and waited in the doorway. When the troll moved again, he spotted an opening and struck.
What design pattern lets the same fighter choose a different way to fight simply by swapping masks?
